entries.what: Hutt et al. 'Design Studies for an Artificial Surfing Reef: Cable Station, Western Australia', Coasts and Ports 99 (card R8; ResearchGate listing 264880547)
entries.detail: ResearchGate returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; the abstract came from web-search snippets. The same content was later found as a 5-page PDF mirror (Pattiaratchi 1999, CWR UWA ED1483CP, http://joas.free.fr/studies/bei/g2s/reefdesign.pdf, card R21), whose title page lists Pattiaratchi as sole author, so the 'Hutt et al.' attribution is probably a snippet error. The mirror's Figures 4 and 7 are low-resolution 1999 photocopies with illegible scale bars, so apex direction and scale could not be read from them (the design drawing in Blacka 2013 Fig A.2 was used instead).
entries.might_work: A clean copy of the Coasts and Ports 99 paper with legible figures (Lior via ResearchGate / UWA library)

entries.detail: The 'DoT WA Coastal Engineering Records' and the 'RWR dossier 2024' could not be located. The Pattiaratchi report that was found (the 1999 design paper, R21) contradicts Gemini's description of it. Only Gemini's crest value is plausible (inside our 1-3 m range) but its LAT datum is unconfirmed; the apex direction cannot be confirmed at Gemini's precision. Gemini lead not confirmed; not used.

entries.what: EMODnet Bathymetry DTM 2024 (viewer, REST, ERDDAP) for seabed depth at the reef
entries.where: https://emodnet.ec.europa.eu/geoviewer/ ; EMODnet Bathymetry REST depth_sample / ERDDAP bathymetry_dtm_2024 at -32.0000, 115.7400
entries.detail: EMODnet covers European seas only; the REST service returns HTTP 204 (empty) at this reef's coordinate (Australia), so the site is outside the grid. Only two of the 13 reefs are covered (Boscombe, Borth). Do not retry EMODnet for this reef.
